name: Akari Hotel
description: Akari Hotel — a block theme for a boutique city hotel. An ink wordmark screen opens the home page with a two-line serif name, a small arrival photograph and an info bar of the four times of the guest day; giant solid-ink serif chapter words cross the edges of photographs, the three room types stack flush right on an ink band, and a hairline grows across before each chapter. Cormorant Garamond for headings, Nunito Sans for reading. Sample content in English: home page, ten inner pages, a journal with one guest note and an enquiry form. WCAG AA colours; scroll effects respect reduced motion.

fonts.role: display: wordmark, chapter words, headings, prices (variable 300-700, roman and italic, Latin subset)
text: body, labels, navigation (variable, Latin subset)

summary.en: A boutique city hotel: an ink wordmark screen, giant serif chapter words over photographs and a sticky room stack.
